dashboardDefinition: (os.totalmem() - os.freemem()) / 1e9, including filesystem caches. It is a whole-host occupancy figure, not application RSS.

osSnapshot.warning: These categories overlap and must not be summed. Snapshot counters do not establish a long-term pressure or leak trend.

interpretation: The headline does not exceed the 16 GiB physical capacity when units are compared correctly. Substantial file-backed/inactive memory is present, with no swap in use at this snapshot. This figure must not be attributed to Lume. Exact-artifact Lume RSS trend and scroll CPU remain the separate native acceptance evidence.

uiSmokeResources.scope: Node verifier plus fresh multi-process headless Chrome, not Lume
uiSmokeResources.samplingNote: RSS sums may count shared pages more than once; startup/layout work is included. No persistent test browser was left running.
